**Daily Devotional**

**March 22**

*7 I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee. (Psalms 2:7 KJV)*

This is God the Father speaking to Jesus. As explained in the Word, (Acts 13:33), this is speaking of when Jesus was resurrected from the dead, and born again to everlasting life. This is one example of Old Testament scripture that foretells the death and resurrection of Jesus, the Son of God the Father. When Isaiah was giving his prophecy about the coming Messiah, he stopped and said “Who hath believed” (Isaiah 53:1) and I sure agree that the fact that God would come to earth as a man and die for us, is hard to believe, but it happened. That shows the love and wisdom of our Heavenly Father, who is love (1 John 4:8), and who would have thought that He would love us so much, even when we were still sinners, that He would do this for us (Romans 5:8).

You need to give a lot of thought to the love that God the Father has for His children. If you ever get hold of the depth of His love for us (Ephesians 3:18-19), you will want to serve Him all your days, and do what little you can, to try and be worthy of that kind of love. Praise God for loving us so much.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
